# kinde_feature_flag (Resource)

Feature flags in the environment the provider is authenticated against. Kinde can't return a single flag, so `name`, `description` and `allow_override_level` are not refreshed from Kinde, and `default_value` is only refreshed for flags that can't be overridden at environment level. See [documentation](https://docs.kinde.com/kinde-apis/management/#tag/feature-flags) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kinde_feature_flag" "beta_access" {
  key                  = "beta_access"
  name                 = "Beta access"
  description          = "Gives organizations access to beta features"
  type                 = "bool"
  allow_override_level = "org"
  default_value        = "false"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allow_override_level` (String) The one level the flag can be overridden at: `env` (environment), `org` (organization) or `usr` (user). Overrides at any other level are rejected by Kinde.
- `default_value` (String) The default value, as a string: `"true"` or `"false"` for `bool` flags and a whole number for `int` flags.
- `key` (String) The flag identifier to use in code. Changing it replaces the flag.
- `name` (String) The name of the flag.
- `type` (String) The value type: `str`, `int` or `bool`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the flag's purpose.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The flag's key.
